UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT
AS TO ECF NOS. 66, 67, AND 76
Plaintiff waives oral argument on Plaintiff’s Rule 72(a) Objections to ECF Nos. 63–65 and Motion to Set Aside ECF No. 64, Suspend Enforcement and Discovery Briefing, and Restore Oral Argument Following Determination of ECF No. 59 (ECF Nos. 66, 67) and on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Notice of Subsequent Record Development Relevant to Pending Rule 72(a) Objections (ECF No. 76), and requests that the Court determine those motions on the papers under Local Civil Rule 7(J).
This notice addresses only the manner of determination of ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76. This notice does not withdraw or modify any relief requested in those filings, including the request for oral argument on ECF Nos. 15 and 54 stated in ECF No. 67 ¶ 6(d) and ECF No. 68 Part VIII.
Plaintiff requests determination of ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76 notwithstanding the entry of ECF No. 84 on October 7, 2026, which Plaintiff will address separately.
Date: October 12, 2026		Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I hereby certify that on October 12, 2026, I submitted the following documents to the Clerk of Court for filing through the Court’s Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):
1. 	Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76;
2. 	Certification Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N);
3. 	Generative-Artificial-Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification pursuant to ECF Nos. 63, 65, and 82; and
4. 	this Certificate of Service.
I further certify that, upon the Clerk’s docketing of the submission on the Court’s Case Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system, a Notice of Electronic Filing will be transmitted to counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc., who are registered users of that system and will be served through that means.
Date: October 12, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO LOCAL CIVIL RULE 83.1(N)
Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N), I declare under penalty of perjury that no attorney has prepared, or assisted in the preparation of, any of the following documents:
1. 	Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76;
2. 	the Certificate of Service accompanying the Notice;
3. 	the Generative-Artificial-Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification accompanying the Notice; and
4. 	this Certification Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N).
This certification applies to each and every document identified above.
Name of Pro Se Litigant: Marvelle J. Ballentine
Signature of Pro Se Litigant
Executed on: October 12, 2026
GENERATIVE-ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE DISCLOSURE AND
CITATION CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO ECF NOS. 63, 65, AND 82
Pursuant to the Orders entered September 9, 2026 (ECF No. 63), September 10, 2026 (ECF No. 65), and September 22, 2026 (ECF No. 82), Plaintiff states as follows.
1. Identification of use. Plaintiff used generative artificial intelligence in the preparation of the Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76 submitted with this filing. The assistance consisted of research, drafting, and revision of text; retrieval of docket entries and filed documents from the public RECAP archive; and verification of record citations against the docket. Plaintiff reviewed, edited, and adopted the document as his own submission.
2. Citation review. Plaintiff certifies that he has reviewed each citation to legal authority and each citation to the record in the document identified in paragraph 1 for accuracy. Plaintiff performed that review using automated citation-verification tools to verify cited authorities against published sources and by comparing each record citation to the document as docketed.
3. Method. ECF Nos. 63, 65, and 82 do not specify the form or placement of this disclosure. Plaintiff places the disclosure and certification in each motion filing and separately docketed memorandum, with the motion’s certification expressly covering the AI-assisted attachments identified in paragraph 1. Plaintiff supplies this disclosure and certification while maintaining the authority-and-scope objection stated in Part IX of the Memorandum in Support of his Rule 72(a) Objections (ECF No. 68). Plaintiff requests approval of this method, or specification of a different method, for any requirement that remains in effect.
Date: October 12, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
